insert_modification.sql:
INSERT INTO "schema"."mods" 
            (row_pk, column_name, old_value, new_value, mod_type, created_by)
        VALUES 
            (:row_pk, :column_name, :old_value, :new_value, :mod_type, :created_by)
        RETURNING id

undo_modification.sql:
UPDATE "schema"."mods"
        SET undone = TRUE
        WHERE id = :mod_id
        RETURNING id

lateral_join_mods_status.sql:
SELECT d.*,
            COALESCE(
                (SELECT m.mod_type 
                 FROM "schema"."mods" m 
                 WHERE m.row_pk->>'PatientID_Mutsequence' = d."PatientID_Mutsequence"::text
                   AND m.undone = FALSE
                 ORDER BY m.created_at DESC 
                 LIMIT 1),
                'unprocessed'
            ) AS _mod_status,
            (SELECT COUNT(*) 
             FROM "schema"."mods" m 
             WHERE m.row_pk->>'PatientID_Mutsequence' = d."PatientID_Mutsequence"::text
               AND m.undone = FALSE
               AND m.mod_type = 'field_modification'
            ) AS _mod_count
        FROM "schema"."data" d
         ORDER BY "PatientID_Mutsequence" ASC LIMIT :limit OFFSET :offset

no_mods_status.sql: SELECT * FROM "schema"."data" ORDER BY "PatientID_Mutsequence" ASC LIMIT :limit OFFSET :offset

upsert_state.sql:
INSERT INTO "public"."ui_state" 
            (user_id, session_id, filters, sort_column, sort_ascending, 
             current_page, rows_per_page, column_preset, updated_at)
        VALUES 
            (:user_id, :session_id, :filters, :sort_column, :sort_ascending,
             :current_page, :rows_per_page, :column_preset, NOW())
        ON CONFLICT (user_id, session_id) 
        DO UPDATE SET
            filters = EXCLUDED.filters,
            sort_column = EXCLUDED.sort_column,
            sort_ascending = EXCLUDED.sort_ascending,
            current_page = EXCLUDED.current_page,
            rows_per_page = EXCLUDED.rows_per_page,
            column_preset = EXCLUDED.column_preset,
            updated_at = NOW()

get_state.sql:
SELECT * FROM "public"."ui_state"
        WHERE user_id = :user_id AND session_id = :session_id

get_modifications_for_row.sql:
SELECT * FROM "schema"."mods"
        WHERE row_pk = :row_pk
          AND undone = FALSE
        ORDER BY created_at DESC

full_filter_sort_paginate_mods.sql:
SELECT d.*,
            COALESCE(
                (SELECT m.mod_type 
                 FROM "epi"."modifications" m 
                 WHERE m.row_pk->>'PatientID_Mutsequence' = d."PatientID_Mutsequence"::text
                   AND m.undone = FALSE
                 ORDER BY m.created_at DESC 
                 LIMIT 1),
                'unprocessed'
            ) AS _mod_status,
            (SELECT COUNT(*) 
             FROM "epi"."modifications" m 
             WHERE m.row_pk->>'PatientID_Mutsequence' = d."PatientID_Mutsequence"::text
               AND m.undone = FALSE
               AND m.mod_type = 'field_modification'
            ) AS _mod_count
        FROM "epi"."epitopes_data" d
         WHERE "Gene_names" IN (:f0_Gene_names_0, :f0_Gene_names_1) AND "Status" ILIKE :f1_Status ORDER BY "PatientID" DESC LIMIT :limit OFFSET :offset
